Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 89. Category: form. Ancient Super Saiyan.

Transformation
The form of the original super saiyan. This appears to
be the only form in which an ancient saiyan retains its
base disposition. This looks like the pure super saiyan
form, accompanied by white lightning.
You gain an amount of Power equal to your Ki Rank
Increase your Movement Speed by 25 ft.
You deal an additional 1d6 to all damage
drains 3 Stamina at the end of your turn
